title: Wall , dance.
script:
-- =====================================================================
-- TRL MODE - ULTIMATE PRO DASHBOARD (v5.0 FULL EDITION)
-- Developed by TAIM | Designed for Delta Executor (All Maps)
-- =====================================================================

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Clean up previous instances
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("TRL_UltimateDashboard") then
    CoreGui.TRL_UltimateDashboard:Destroy()
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TRL_UltimateDashboard"
ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

-- ==================== 1. CYBERPUNK LOADING SCREEN (6 SECONDS) ====================
local LoadScreen = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
LoadScreen.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 12)
LoadScreen.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -80)
LoadScreen.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 160)
Instance.new("UICorner", LoadScreen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
local LoadStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", LoadScreen)
LoadStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
LoadStroke.Thickness = 1.5

local LoadTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", LoadScreen)
LoadTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 15)
LoadTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
LoadTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
LoadTitle.Text = "⚡ TRL MODE INITIALIZING"
LoadTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
LoadTitle.TextSize = 13

local LoadStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel", LoadScreen)
LoadStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LoadStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
LoadStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
LoadStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
LoadStatus.Text = "Initializing core systems..."
LoadStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
LoadStatus.TextSize = 11

local BarBg = Instance.new("Frame", LoadScreen)
BarBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
BarBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 90)
BarBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 8)
Instance.new("UICorner", BarBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local BarFill = Instance.new("Frame", BarBg)
BarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
Instance.new("UICorner", BarFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

-- ==================== 2. FLOATING TOGGLE BUTTON ====================
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", ScreenGui)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.4, 0)
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ToggleBtn.Text = "TRL"
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 15
ToggleBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
ToggleBtn.Visible = false
Instance.new("UICorner", ToggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local ToggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", ToggleBtn)
ToggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
ToggleStroke.Thickness = 2

-- ==================== 3. MAIN DASHBOARD FRAME ====================
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 85, 0.3, 0)
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 310, 0, 440)
MainFrame.Visible = false
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", MainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", MainFrame)
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
MainStroke.Thickness = 1.5

-- Top Bar
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
TopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
Instance.new("UICorner", TopBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

local FixCorner = Instance.new("Frame", TopBar)
FixCorner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 22)
FixCorner.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
FixCorner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
FixCorner.BorderSizePixel = 0

local TitleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", TopBar)
TitleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 0)
TitleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 1, 0)
TitleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleLabel.Text = "⚡ TRL MODE v5.0"
TitleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleLabel.TextSize = 13
TitleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- Close Button (X)
local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TopBar)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.Text = "X"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", CloseBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

-- Tabs Bar (5 Tabs)
local TabBar = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
TabBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 48)
TabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 32)
TabBar.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 0)
TabBar.ScrollBarThickness = 0

local TabListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", TabBar)
TabListLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
TabListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)

-- Pages Container
local PagesContainer = Instance.new("Frame", MainFrame)
PagesContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PagesContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 88)
PagesContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -98)

local function CreatePage()
    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", PagesContainer)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 400)
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
    page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
    page.Visible = false
    local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", page)
    layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    return page
end

local PagePlayers = CreatePage()
local PageMovement = CreatePage()
local PageBody     = CreatePage()
local PageEmotes   = CreatePage()
local PageChangelog= CreatePage()

local function CreateTabButton(name, order, targetPage)
    local tabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabBar)
    tabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 65, 1, 0)
    tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
    tabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tabBtn.Text = name
    tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
    tabBtn.TextSize = 11
    tabBtn.LayoutOrder = order
    Instance.new("UICorner", tabBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    tabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        PagePlayers.Visible = false
        PageMovement.Visible = false
        PageBody.Visible = false
        PageEmotes.Visible = false
        PageChangelog.Visible = false
        targetPage.Visible = true
        
        for _, child in ipairs(TabBar:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                child.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
                child.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
            end
        end
        tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 140)
        tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end)
    return tabBtn
end

local Tab1 = CreateTabButton("👤 Players", 1, PagePlayers)
local Tab2 = CreateTabButton("🚀 Move", 2, PageMovement)
local Tab3 = CreateTabButton("💀 Body", 3, PageBody)
local Tab4 = CreateTabButton("🎭 Emotes", 4, PageEmotes)
local Tab5 = CreateTabButton("📜 Logs", 5, PageChangelog)

PagePlayers.Visible = true
Tab1.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 140)
Tab1.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- ==================== 1. PLAYERS TAB (TP + ESP #9) ====================
local PlayersLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", PagePlayers)
PlayersLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
PlayersLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)

local espActive = false
local espHighlights = {}

local function ToggleESP(btn)
    espActive = not espActive
    if espActive then
        btn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [ON]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
        -- Create ESP
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= Player and p.Character then
                local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                hl.Adornee = p.Character
                hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
                hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                hl.Parent = p.Character
                espHighlights[p] = hl
            end
        end
    else
        btn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [OFF]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
        for _, hl in pairs(espHighlights) do
            hl:Destroy()
        end
        espHighlights = {}
    end
end

local espBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PagePlayers)
espBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
espBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 25, 35)
espBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
espBtn.Text = "👁️ ESP Highlights: [OFF]"
espBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
espBtn.TextSize = 12
Instance.new("UICorner", espBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() ToggleESP(espBtn) end)

local function UpdatePlayerList()
    for _, child in ipairs(PagePlayers:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") and child ~= espBtn then child:Destroy() end
    end
    local count = 1
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= Player then
            count = count + 1
            local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PagePlayers)
            pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
            pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
            pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            pBtn.Text = " ➔ TP to: " .. plr.Name
            pBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 250)
            pBtn.TextSize = 12
            pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            Instance.new("UICorner", pBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            
            pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local tChar, mChar = plr.Character, Player.Character
                if tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    mChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = tChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    PagePlayers.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, count * 42)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    UpdatePlayerList()
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if espActive then
            task.wait(1)
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Adornee = char
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
            hl.Parent = char
            espHighlights[p] = hl
        end
    end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(UpdatePlayerList)
UpdatePlayerList()

-- ==================== 2. MOVEMENT TAB (#1, #2, #3, #6, #7, #8) ====================
local function CreateMoveBtn(name, color, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", PageMovement)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = color
    btn.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() callback(btn) end)
    return btn
end

-- #1 Fly Mode
local flying = false
local flyConnection
CreateMoveBtn("🕊️ Fly Mode (Flight)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200), function(btn)
    flying = not flying
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if flying then
        btn.Text = "🕊️ Fly Mode: [ON]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
        flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5)
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * 1.5)
            end
        end)
    else
        btn.Text = "🕊️ Fly Mode (Flight)"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200)
        if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() end
    end
end)

-- #2 Infinite Jump
local infJumpActive = false
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJumpActive then
        local char = Player.Character
        if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            char.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end)
CreateMoveBtn("🦘 Infinite Jump", Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255), function(btn)
    infJumpActive = not infJumpActive
    btn.Text = infJumpActive and "🦘 Infinite Jump: [ON]" or "🦘 Infinite Jump"
    btn.TextColor3 = infJumpActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
end)

-- #3 Speed Hack
local speedActive = false
CreateMoveBtn("⚡ Speed Hack (Boost)", Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), function(btn)
    speedActive = not speedActive
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = speedActive and 45 or 16
        btn.Text = speedActive and "⚡ Speed Hack: [ON]" or "⚡ Speed Hack (Boost)"
        btn.TextColor3 = speedActive and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
    end
end)

-- #6 SpinBot (Crazy 360)
local spinning = false
CreateMoveBtn("🌀 SpinBot (360 Spin)", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 255), function(btn)
    spinning = not spinning
    btn.Text = spinning and "🌀 SpinBot: [ON]" or "🌀 SpinBot (360 Spin)"
    btn.TextColor3 = spinning and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 255)
    task.spawn(function()
        while spinning do
            local char = Player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(30), 0)
            end
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end)

-- #7 Platform Spawn
CreateMoveBtn("🧱 Spawn Platform Under Me", Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local p = Instance.new("Part", Workspace)
        p.Size = Vector3.new(5, 1, 5)
        p.Position = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        p.Anchored = true
        p.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Neon orange")
        task.delay(5, function() p:Destroy() end)
    end
end)

-- #8 Zoom Out FOV Extender
local fovExpanded = false
CreateMoveBtn("🔭 FOV Extender (Zoom Out)", Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255), function(btn)
    fovExpanded = not fovExpanded
    Camera.FieldOfView = fovExpanded and 105 or 70
    btn.Text = fovExpanded and "🔭 FOV Extender: [105]" or "🔭 FOV Extender (Zoom Out)"
end)
PageMovement.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 260)

-- ==================== 3. BODY & TOOLS TAB (#4, #5, #10 + Noclip) ====================
local function CreateBodyBtn(name, color, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", PageBody)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = color
    btn.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    stroke.Color = color
    stroke.Transparency = 0.5
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() callback(btn) end)
    return btn
end

-- Noclip
local noclipActive = false
local noclipConn
CreateBodyBtn("🧱 Noclip (Walk Through Walls)", Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0), function(btn)
    noclipActive = not noclipActive
    if noclipActive then
        noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            local char = Player.Character
            if char then
                for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)
        btn.Text = "🧱 Noclip: [ON]"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
    else
        if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() end
        btn.Text = "🧱 Noclip (Walk Through Walls)"
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 0)
    end
end)

-- #5 Invisible Mode
local invisible = false
CreateBodyBtn("👻 Invisible Mode (Ghost)", Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200), function(btn)
    invisible = not invisible
    local char = Player.Character
    if char then
        local t = invisible and 1 or 0
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") or part.Name == "Head" then
                part.Transparency = t
            end
        end
    end
    btn.Text = invisible and "👻 Invisible Mode: [ON]" or "👻 Invisible Mode (Ghost)"
    btn.TextColor3 = invisible and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
end)

-- Limbs Hide
local limbsHidden = false
CreateBodyBtn("👤 Toggle Limbs Transparency", Color3.fromRGB(200, 100, 255), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if not char then return end
    limbsHidden = not limbsHidden
    local t = limbsHidden and 1 or 0
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "Head" and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = t
        end
    end
end)

-- Giant Size
CreateBodyBtn("🗿 Giant Avatar Scale", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 200), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        pcall(function()
            char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
            char.Humanoid.BodyDepthScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.BodyHeightScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.BodyWidthScale.Value = 2
            char.Humanoid.HeadScale.Value = 2
        end)
    end
end)

-- #10 Instant Sit
CreateBodyBtn("🪑 Instant Sit Down", Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 150), function()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        char.Humanoid.Sit = true
    end
end)
PageBody.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 220)

-- ==================== 4. EMOTES TAB ====================
local function StopAllEmotes()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        for _, track in ipairs(char.Humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            track:Stop()
        end
    end
end

local function PlayEmote(animId)
    StopAllEmotes()
    local char = Player.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. animId
        char.Humanoid:LoadAnimation(anim):Play()
    end
end

local EmotesList = {
    {"👋 Wave Emote", "507770239"},
    {"😂 Laugh Emote", "507770677"},
    {"🎖️ Salute Emote", "507771019"},
    {"💀 Head Toss (Head Off)", "3338009055"}
}

for _, data in ipairs(EmotesList) do
    local eBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PageEmotes)
    eBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
    eBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)
    eBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    eBtn.Text = data[1]
    eBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
    eBtn.TextSize = 12
    Instance.new("UICorner", eBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    eBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() PlayEmote(data[2]) end)
end
PageEmotes.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #EmotesList * 44)

-- ==================== 5. CHANGELOG (UPDATE HISTORY) ====================
local ChangelogBox = Instance.new("TextLabel", PageChangelog)
ChangelogBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ChangelogBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 1, 0)
ChangelogBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
ChangelogBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 240)
ChangelogBox.TextSize = 11
ChangelogBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
ChangelogBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
ChangelogBox.TextWrapped = true
ChangelogBox.Text = [[
[ TRL MODE - OFFICIAL CHANGELOG ]

v1.0 (Initial Release):
• Basic UI framework & toggle button.
• Classic Roblox animations integration.

v2.0 (Expansion):
• Added custom Close button with instant cleanup.
• Added Head Toss emote.

v3.0 (Advanced Tools):
• Experimental Noclip module added.
• Universal Player Teleport list.

v4.0 (OLED & English Upgrade):
• Redesigned UI to full English & OLED Neon.
• Added 6-second dynamic loading screen.

v5.0 (ULTIMATE EDITION - CURRENT):
• Added all 10 requested features!
• Fly Mode, Inf Jump, Speed Hack, SpinBot.
• Platform Spawn, FOV Extender, ESP Highlights.
• Invisible Mode & Instant Sit.
• Full multi-tab interactive dashboard.
]]
PageChangelog.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 320)

-- ==================== LOADING SEQUENCE (6 SECONDS WITH DYNAMIC TEXT) ====================
task.spawn(function()
    local steps = 60
    local sleepTime = 6 / steps
    
    for i = 1, steps do
        local percent = math.floor((i / steps) * 100)
        BarFill.Size = UDim2.new(i / steps, 0, 1, 0)
        
        if percent < 20 then
            LoadStatus.Text = "Initializing TRL Security... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        elseif percent < 45 then
            LoadStatus.Text = "Injecting UI modules... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        elseif percent < 75 then
            LoadStatus.Text = "Bypassing anti-cheat systems... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        else
            LoadStatus.Text = "Finalizing TRL Mode v5.0... (" .. percent .. "%)"
        end
        
        task.wait(sleepTime)
    end
    
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(LoadScreen, tweenInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    for _, child in ipairs(LoadScreen:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
            TweenService:Create(child, tweenInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
        elseif child:IsA("Frame") then
            TweenService:Create(child, tweenInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
        end
    end
    
    task.wait(0.6)
    LoadScreen:Destroy()
    ToggleBtn.Visible = true
end)

-- ==================== DASHBOARD CONTROLS ====================
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    StopAllEmotes()
    if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() end
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() end
    for _, hl in pairs(espHighlights) do hl:Destroy() end
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = not MainFrame.Visible
    if MainFrame.Visible then UpdatePlayerList() end
end)
